vo_hdt_physical_referent.evidence: At native and thumbnail scales, a solid adult woman in black is clearly present on the left and spatially distinct from the full-height translucent blue counterpart on the right.

vo_hdt_corresponding_current_state.evidence: Both scales show the counterpart repeating the woman’s long dark wavy hair, oval face, black clothing, and raised-arm working pose; native pixels also expose internal heart and physiological layers.

vo_hdt_outbound_live_sensing.evidence: Native pixels show a blue luminous dotted stream originating at the physical woman’s sensor bracelet and raised wrist, explicitly labeled BIOSENSOR DATA STREAM and LIVE SYNC, traveling toward the digital model.

vo_hdt_returned_update.evidence: Native pixels show a separate warm-orange arc descending from the counterpart and forecast area toward the physical coastal model, labeled PREDICTIVE UPDATE, ROUTE OPTIMIZATION, and RETURN SYNC.

vo_hdt_not_static_double_or_shadow.evidence: At thumbnail scale, the paired blue outbound stream and orange returned-update arc remain visible together, while red and green rerouted evacuation paths visibly alter the physical table model; the counterpart therefore reads as an active two-way system rather than a static duplicate.

supplemental_observations.reference_role: The supplied portrait was used only as physical and digital appearance inspiration; this review makes no biometric identity claim.
supplemental_observations.partial_policy: No partial status was used; any ambiguous gate would have been recorded as fail.
supplemental_observations.text_note: Small diegetic interface text is imperfect in places, but the five semantic gates are carried by figure separation, colored paths, state layers, and route changes rather than text alone.
